availabilityFilter.available: display.internalName has a matching signed manifest jars.internalName entry
availabilityFilter.hiddenOrDisabledFlags: No hidden or disabled fields occur in this signed manifest display schema. No such flags are invented.
availabilityFilter.warnings: Retained verbatim as metadata; warning presence does not imply JAR unavailability.
availabilityFilter.buildFailuresAndUnavailableReasons: Retained independently; JAR matching remains the exact availability rule.

websiteCrossCheck.reason: The server-rendered website is an older cached snapshot than the signed manifest/current count endpoint. Metrics are not mixed.

statusSemantics.implemented: The named, bounded capability exists in inspected Runewarden code; this is not complete upstream-plugin parity.
statusSemantics.partial: A limited subset or public native-plugin integration exists; remaining breadth is explicit.
statusSemantics.missing: No corresponding owned implementation was identified in the inspected source snapshot.
statusSemantics.unknown: Primary documentation is insufficient for a specific capability comparison; no behaviour or parity is invented.

limitations: This is a source/documentation comparison, not in-game validation or RuneLite approval.
Source/test paths and hashes are indexed for Runewarden 0.9.6 under com.runewarden; this namespace reindex is not new test-execution evidence or Hub approval.
The 151-plugin popularity tier is complete for the recorded threshold and snapshot; every other inventory record remains explicitly unreviewed.
A README capability baseline does not certify parity with every upstream source option or undocumented edge case.
A guide, item catalogue, static reference, generic tick, self HUD or native-plugin adapter is not counted as a full specialist implementation.
Referenced tests are evidence pointers; the audit generator does not execute those tests.
Real-companion contracts are optional integration evidence, not default plugin-only test coverage; development-launcher tests are excluded.
Current and future changes require re-review of capability statuses; source hashes identify the inspected snapshot.
The GitHub marker source pin is independently recorded. The manifest does not expose a source commit that cryptographically binds a README to its built JAR.
A Hub-listed feature is precedent for investigation, not an automatic approval of a new implementation. No unsupported blanket prohibition is inferred.

comparisons.qualification: GuideNavigation uses public plugin messages for routing and confirms receiver acceptance. The production plugin uses an optional separately installed/enabled Shortest Path; this export bundles no companion source or binary. Default tests use an identity-only discovery fixture. The two unchanged real-companion contracts are retained under integration-tests/java, require an externally supplied Shortest Path 1.21.3 JAR at the recorded pin and are not part of default test coverage. The excluded development-launcher startup tests establish no coverage here. Completed advice reads fixed public getters, copies bounded summary facts and launches no query search. Guide preparation has 94 sourced arrival points for 112 training/minigame guide IDs; method/combat positions and unsourced destinations remain excluded. Farm preparation compares eligible patch destinations using native current-position/account/transport costs; custom runs keep their next stop and order. My POH stores character declarations, scans only verified own building-mode houses and requires explicit application; a cape never implies furniture. Inventory-mode teleports use carried/equipped rather than banked-only items. Owned refresh is coalesced and manual routes are preserved. Catalog membership is not destination coverage, and the native engine is not a Runewarden implementation.

supplementalNativeExtensions.title: Integrated World Hopper
supplementalNativeExtensions.reviewScope: Selected owned native extension; not a complete built-in plugin comparison and excluded from Hub finding counts
implementedMechanisms: Official world list and native population updates; country and US-coast flags, search, membership/region/type filters, character favourites and six reversible sorts
Explicit row/return/previous/next actions, configurable quick-hop keys, namespaced command and friends/chat/clan Hop-to entries with fresh entry checks and native confirmations
Special-world approval invalidation on changed world types, profile/connection-generation guards and a bounded worker for TCP latency plus optional native retransmission HUD
remainingLimits: Manual hops only; native entry restrictions and confirmations remain authoritative, and headless cases do not establish live world switching
Uses ::rwhop, unbound default keys, all saved quick-hop filters and character favourites instead of identical native preferences

TCP-connect probes differ from native ICMP-first measurements; three-second probe spacing/current priority after six seconds is not a response-time guarantee, OS DNS can block the single worker, and network history/lag analytics remain absent

supplementalNativeExtensions.title: Native Agility coaching
supplementalNativeExtensions.reviewScope: Selected owned native extension; not a complete built-in plugin comparison and excluded from Hub finding counts
implementedMechanisms: Native course, obstacle and shortcut observations with exact-XP/end-position lap confirmation
Measured course sessions, level goals, mark/stick observations and Brimhaven target-change estimates
remainingLimits: No weighted Brimhaven route solver, full Sepulchre trap/runner engine or Dorgesh-Kaan/Underwater task routes
Broad native region recognition is not an exact course-boundary or universal traversal engine

supplementalNativeExtensions.title: Contextual ground loot and native loot beams
supplementalNativeExtensions.reviewScope: Selected owned native extension; not a complete built-in plugin comparison and excluded from Hub finding counts
implementedMechanisms: Native identity/ownership/deadline-aware floor-item highlights and guide/manual targets
Five configurable value-band beams using native models, bounded object caches and actual despawn/public rings
remainingLimits: Floor-item eligibility is not path reachability and does not add earned loot
This is not every native Ground Items menu, rule or display feature

supplementalNativeExtensions.title: Gathering, harvest and observed farming HUDs
supplementalNativeExtensions.reviewScope: Selected owned native extension; not a complete built-in plugin comparison and excluded from Hub finding counts
implementedMechanisms: Observed respawn windows, supported estimated tree lifetimes and text/radial choices
Native Time Tracking harvest summaries, crop-specific icons, cycle-aligned patch growth estimates and confirmed compost evidence
remainingLimits: Unknown/random resource lifetimes and unobserved crop states remain unknown; disease and growth skips can alter estimates
Native Time Tracking integration is retained; full original tracker replacement is not claimed

Multiplayer party transport and synchronized peer-state panels
